QuestInfo.name: Icarus's Hang Glider
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, there's someone in #m10003000# by the name of #p407# that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.
QuestInfo.1: I went to meet #b#p407##k on top of a building in #m10003000#. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him #b30 #t4000017#s#k, #b10 #t4003001#s#k, and #b15 #t4003002#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I got the materials #p407# needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I don't really know if this will work, but who knows, he could end up succeeding. I should check up on him when he's done building it.

0.0: Wouldn't it be incredible to swim in those clouds and fly your way through freedom? I wonder what it's like to fly, free as a bird. Even if it's only for a few minutes, I'd be more than happy to just be up there! \r\n#L0# #bCan humans really fly?#k\r\n#L1# #bGrow up, you know we can't fly.#k#l
0.1: Oh yeah, I truly believe we're meant to fly, and I will try my hardest to make that wish come true! That got me thinking, in order to fulfill my dream, I should make a huge hang glider! I read about it in a book, and it said you can fly like a bird using a hang glider. All I need now are the materials to build it, and... do you want to help me out here? If you get me the materials, I'll definitely let you ride on it. What do you think?

yes.0: I knew you'd help me out! Together we can make the most awesome hang glider ever! I was thinking, in order to make it happen, I'll need #b30 #t4000017#s#k for the wings, #b10 pieces of #t4003001#s#k for the framework, and #b15 #t4003002#s#k to make the flight as smooth as possible. You'll see a lot of #o17#'s in the subway station nearby, so you should check it out!

no.0: I can't believe you're giving up on such a golden opportunity to fly. If that's the case, then I'm going to try to make it myself! You'll see!!!

0.1: You're just like everyone else, living in a box. Wake up, think OUTSIDE the box! You'll see... You'll see me flying around here some day.

1.0: I've been waiting for a looong time! While you were out, gathering up the materials, I drew up the perfect blueprint for the glider! All we need now is to follow through with the plan, and we'll be up in the skies in no time! Did you gather all the materials?

yes.0: Wow, that's a lot of stuff!! Well, I'll have to get started on making the hang glider. Drop by sometime later, I should be done by then. We'll be flying in no time!

item.0: Did you get all the materials I asked for? I don't think you have all of them! Please gather #b30 #t4000017#s#k, #b10 pieces of #t4003001#s#k, and #b15 #t4003002#s#k! The faster you get them for me, the earlier we'll be flying up in the air!
